args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Investigation:**
- `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions — confirmed rolled out across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback; on-call was paged.

**Verification:**
- Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, **healthy** in all regions, with error rate dropped to 0.002.
